description: Hidden rule that decides each synthetic deal's outcome. Used only by the generator and by evaluation (do the model's top drivers match these?). The app never reads this file.

notes.exec_engaged: 1 if an executive (C-level or VP) on the customer side engaged in meetings
notes.champion: 1 if a champion contact role exists
notes.competitor: 1 if a named competitor is in the deal
notes.close_pushes: number of times the close date moved later
notes.activity_level_minus_1: relative activity rate minus 1 (0.3 to 1.8 before centring)
notes.severe_cases: Sev-1/Sev-2 support cases open on the account during the deal
notes.expansion: 1 for an expansion of an existing customer
